name: C064 Tu Sĩ Hồi Phục Chậm (Trượng Bình Thảo Dược Sinh Mệnh)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a dark-fantasy Herbalist Monk's life-dew censer staff (Trượng Bình Thảo Dược Sinh Mệnh - C064 Tu Sĩ Hồi Phục Chậm) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete herbalist druid staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (gnarled living root-wood shaft) to top-right (braided wooden branches cradling an emerald-green glass alchemy flask and bronze herbal censer dripping glowing green life-dew).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom root-tip to top herbal flask with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use rich brown oak, weathered bronze, forest green moss, and luminous emerald healing elixir).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Herbalist Life-Dew Staff (Trượng Bình Thảo Dược Sinh Mệnh - C064 Tu Sĩ Hồi Phục Chậm) from the attached reference image.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the gnarly wood and emerald flask staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a twilight monastery herb garden where glowing emerald-green droplets and soothing herbal mist rise from the staff's alchemy vessel.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
